column2: Object clauses with if / whether and question words · 情景运用(第3轮)
if/whether and special question words introduce object clauses; the key exam point is word order.本课为情景运用练习,核心:Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。

if/whether means 'whether'|special question words (what/where/when/how) keep their original meaning|the clause uses statement word order: where he lives|the tense follows the main clause|the expression for polite requests: Could you tell me how to get to...
I don't know whether he will come.
I don't know whether does he come.|I don't know whether he will come.|I don't know whether he comes will.|I don't know whether will he come.
column4: Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。正确句:I don't know whether he will come.
